title: Drought Resilience Profiles: Lesotho
organization: World Bank, CIWA, SADRI, IWMI and National Drought Mitigation Center
temporal_coverage: Drought impacts, risk mapping and institutional preparedness summarized in an undated profile
methodology: Brief drought-risk profile with spatial mapping and qualitative capacity ratings.
limitations: Not an impact evaluation; mapped risk depends on modeled indicators and data quality.

title: Climate Change Key for Lesotho's Domestic and Industrial Water Security, Agricultural Production and Regional Water Transfers
temporal_coverage: Climate and water assessment considers possible future conditions through 2050, as described in 2016
methodology: World Bank page summarizes an assessment of water-system performance under a broad range of future climate conditions and adaptation options.
limitations: The page is a summary of the assessment rather than the full technical report; precipitation projections vary among climate models.

title: IPC Acute Food Insecurity Analysis: Lesotho, May 2025-March 2026
organization: Lesotho Vulnerability Assessment Committee (LVAC); Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC)
temporal_coverage: IPC analysis of acute food insecurity for May 2025-March 2026, with current and projected periods as defined in the report.
methodology: The LVAC/IPC analysis classifies acute food insecurity; its official indexed PDF excerpt reports high evidence level.
limitations: Direct PDF retrieval timed out; claims use only substantive excerpts indexed from the official LVAC report. Forecast periods have ended; outcomes were not checked.

title: Lesotho: El Niño-Related Drought, Office of the Resident Coordinator Situation Update 04
organization: United Nations Office of the Resident Coordinator in Lesotho; Humanitarian Country Team
temporal_coverage: Situation update covering 16 May-25 July 2016 during the El Niño-related drought.
methodology: Humanitarian Country Team situation update drawing on LVAC, protection assessments and partner reporting.
limitations: A time-specific 2016 emergency report; some protection data were incomplete and do not establish current prevalence.

title: United Nations Lesotho Annual Report 2025
organization: United Nations Country Team in Lesotho
methodology: UNCT annual results report compiling reported agency and partner activities and outputs.
limitations: Reported outputs are not an independent evaluation of effectiveness or longer-term resilience outcomes.

title: Lesotho Launches IACoV Phase II to Strengthen Climate Resilience and Food Security
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator Office in Lesotho
temporal_coverage: UN account of the IACoV Phase II launch and project design on 2 March 2026.
methodology: UN publication summarizing project design, district targeting and launch remarks.
limitations: Project plans and launch claims are not an independent evaluation; Phase II intentions are not treated as delivered results.
